name: Folio document desk
when_to_use: Use when a local PDF needs a sha256 slip before a person opens it in external Folio, or when a local Folio clone should be compared to the pinned revision. Does not run Folio.

how_to_change.note: Stdlib only. Do not vendor Folio, do not mark the tool stateless, and do not launch the external app. Keep the tool off the public endpoint.
